verdict.rationale: Dots is an always-on cloud agent with its own browser. It works autonomously, can run background agents in parallel, can delegate to ChatGPT Work, and reaches out with results, which implies it could carry out an autonomous research run. Nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated deep-research mode, multi-source searching, or a report with citations. Missing for 10: an explicit deep-research capability, evidence of searching many sources, cited report output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
